name: Cargo Boat · Round 1
domainSummary: A neutral low-profile cargo barge whose identity comes from a blunt load-bearing bow, an empty central freight well, a raised aft wheelhouse, a broad working deck, and protective side rub rails.
evidenceBoundary: Keep this a generic unowned working vessel. Do not imply a company, route, cargo type, throughput, motion, or destination.

researchSources.title: Career World canonical ambient briefs
researchSources.use: Accepted cargo-boat silhouette, component arrangement, projection, and neutral-evidence boundary.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Canonical Production
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into its clearest production-ready map prop; emphasize flat load-bearing working deck
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested in its most resolved reusable form. This version emphasizes flat load-bearing working deck.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Silhouette Contrast
assets.controlledVariable: push the outer contour and negative spaces for instant recognition at map scale; emphasize blunt stable bow
assets.thesis: A distinct silhouette tests recognition without labels or color. This version emphasizes blunt stable bow.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Weighted Asymmetry
assets.controlledVariable: shift the dominant mass off-center while preserving the asset's practical balance; emphasize open central cargo well
assets.thesis: Controlled asymmetry creates identity without sacrificing function. This version emphasizes open central cargo well.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Functional Exposure
assets.controlledVariable: make the asset's defining working parts structurally legible without diagrams; emphasize raised aft wheelhouse
assets.thesis: Exposed function tests whether the object reads through construction rather than decoration. This version emphasizes raised aft wheelhouse.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Rugged Structure
assets.controlledVariable: strengthen load-bearing edges, joints, guards, and contact points; emphasize side rub rails and fenders
assets.thesis: Rugged construction tests a durable working-world interpretation. This version emphasizes side rub rails and fenders.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Modular Rhythm
assets.controlledVariable: organize repeated functional elements into a clear unequal rhythm on one coherent object or shared base; emphasize flat load-bearing working deck
assets.thesis: A modular cadence tests reuse and system belonging. This version emphasizes flat load-bearing working deck.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Low Profile
assets.controlledVariable: compress height and emphasize a long stable footprint while retaining every defining feature; emphasize blunt stable bow
assets.thesis: A low profile tests legibility in dense map placement. This version emphasizes blunt stable bow.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Vertical Accent
assets.controlledVariable: give one legitimate functional element a taller focal role while keeping the overall prop subordinate to buildings; emphasize open central cargo well
assets.thesis: A vertical accent tests landmark readability without turning the prop into architecture. This version emphasizes open central cargo well.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the asset to the smallest complete form that preserves its exact identity and component count; emphasize raised aft wheelhouse
assets.thesis: The primitive reveals which cues are essential. This version emphasizes raised aft wheelhouse.

assets.name: Cargo Boat · Ambient Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance silhouette, function, construction, modular detail, and map-scale restraint in one production-ready prop; emphasize side rub rails and fenders
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests the complete ambient identity for repeated world use. This version emphasizes side rub rails and fenders.
